**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 19 of the agreement satisfies the preferred WARRANTY position across all material terms:

- **§19.1** — professional and workmanlike standard, qualified personnel, industry standards, plus material conformity to documentation and specifications.
- **§19.2** — 90 days after delivery *or acceptance, whichever is later* for Deliverables; Hosted Services conform for the entire subscription term (better than the 12-month software benchmark).
- **§19.3** — no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality diminishment, open-source protection for Customer source code.
- **§19.4** — re-perform/repair/replace at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid; expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **§19.5** — mutual implied-warranty disclaimer that expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy, so it does not swallow §§19.1–19.3.
